# AutoAyah

Self-hostable Quran video editor (PWA). Generate vertical/horizontal MP4s with recitation and optional tafsir.

## Base URL

Default: http://localhost:3737

## Key endpoints

- GET /api/health
- GET /api/config — appMode, storageMode, capabilities
- GET /api/surahs | /api/reciters | /api/tafsirs | /api/translations
- GET /api/divisions — start/end ayah of every juz, hizb, rub' (quarter), Mushaf page and manzil
- POST /api/preview — body: VideoConfig → timeline + props (no render)
- POST /api/preview?draft=1 — same, text only: no recitation audio or word timings, durations are estimates
- POST /api/jobs — enqueue render
- GET /api/jobs/:id
- GET /api/jobs/:id/events — SSE progress
- POST /api/jobs/:id/cancel | /api/jobs/:id/retry, DELETE /api/jobs/:id
- POST /api/media/search — { query, kind: "image"|"video", page? } → people-free stock results + hasMore
- GET /openapi.json
- POST /mcp — MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0, streamable HTTP): initialize, tools/list, tools/call
- GET /mcp/tools, POST /mcp/call — { name, arguments } plain-REST shim of the same tools

MCP tools: list_capabilities, find_ayat, list_reciters, list_tafsirs, list_translations,
preview_video, render_video, get_job.

When APP_PASSWORD is set, send the session token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
(from POST /api/auth/login).

## VideoConfig (minimal)

```json
{
  "surah": 25,
  "from": 7,
  "to": 8,
  "reciter": "qdc-7",
  "tafsir": "ar.muyassar",
  "mode": "ayahTafsir",
  "aspectRatio": "9:16",
  "export": "mp4"
}
```

Reciter ids (list them with GET /api/reciters): `qdc-<id>` Quran.com recitations (word timings), `qdcch-<id>`
Quran.com whole-surah recordings, `mp3q-<id>` mp3quran.net Hafs recordings (ayah timings only, so `wordHighlight` and
`mushafWords` are rejected), other ids are everyayah folders. Reciters with a whole-surah recording play consecutive ayat as one
uninterrupted stretch of it.

A clip may cross surahs: set `toSurah` (and `to` is then an ayah of that surah). For Juz 30 send
`"surah": 78, "from": 1, "toSurah": 114, "to": 6, "range": { "kind": "juz", "n": 30 }` — take the
refs from /api/divisions. `range` is only a label (kinds: surah, juz, hizb, rub, page, manzil).

`mushafPage` shows the scanned printed Madani page (quran.app public images + ayah coordinates), with a rebuilt 15-line text page as fallback. `mushafWords` is the same scanned page with each recited word boxed on the scan. `wordHighlight` and `mushafWords` need a reciter with word timings (`hasWordTimings` in /api/reciters); there is no estimated fallback.

## CLI

`autoayah render 25:7-10 --mode ayahTafsir --aspect 9:16`
